questions.body: Who is known as the father of C programming language?
hints: He created C in the early 1970s.
questions.explanation: Dennis Ritchie created C at Bell Labs in 1972.

questions.body: C is a high-level programming language.
hints: It is structured and abstract from machine code.

questions.explanation: C is a high-level language that also allows low-level memory manipulation.

questions.body: Which operating system was originally written in C?
hints: Dennis Ritchie also worked on this OS.

questions.explanation: UNIX was rewriting in C, making it the first OS implemented in a high-level language.

questions.body: The tool that converts C source code into machine code is called a _______.

questions.body: What is the extension of a C source file?
